name: Pile of Fireworks (5-6) OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Quest #5: The Dragon who Stole Evoking Day
description: A pile of stolen and volatile fireworks.
disable: DC 21 Crafting (trained), engineering-lore|dc:19|name:Remove Lit Firework (trained), or explosives-lore|dc:19|name:Remove Lit Firework (trained) to safely remove the lit firework or DC 21 Thievery (trained) to remove the lit fuse from the firework.

generalAbilities.name: Light Fuse
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The pile of fireworks takes acid or fire damage.

Effect The fuse of one of the fireworks begins to burn and the pile of fireworks enters initiative immediately before the triggering creature or effect.

generalAbilities.name: Explosive Blast
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger The pile of fireworks begins its turn.

Effect The pile of fireworks explodes, dealing 6d8 Fire Damage damage (Basic DC 25 Reflex Saving Throw) save to all creatures within 15 feet.
